column3: Close to the Hebrew; “the River” is the Euphrates (also in verses 3, 14, 15).
Close to the Hebrew; Hebrew “Sea of Reeds” at the end of the verse is rendered “Red Sea.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the hornet” is an uncertain word, which some take as “panic.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the oak” renders a word that may mean “terebinth.”
